_comment: Step 1 determinism parity vectors for witness-kernel-rust. Language-neutral INPUTS only. Both the Rust test (crates/chronicle/tests/parity.rs) and the TS oracle (gen-golden.mjs) read these, compute canonical_json + blake3 hex, and must agree byte-for-byte. Add tricky cases here; do not hand-edit golden.json. See parity/README.md.

vectors.name: key-order
vectors.note: keys supplied out of order — canonical form must sort them

vectors.name: nested-unordered
vectors.note: nested object keys also sorted recursively

vectors.name: array-order-preserved
vectors.note: array element order is significant and preserved (not sorted)

vectors.name: array-of-objects
vectors.note: objects inside arrays get key-sorted, array order kept

vectors.name: unicode
vectors.note: non-ASCII + emoji — probes UTF-8 byte encoding and string escaping parity

vectors.name: float
vectors.note: INTENTIONAL cross-language risk probe — number formatting may diverge (serde_json vs JS). A failure here is a real finding, not a flake.

vectors.name: event-payload
vectors.note: representative witness event matching the index.ts append shape
